HAG.P.1.1-11.text: A Call to Rebuild the Temple

HAG.P.2.1-9.text: The Coming Glory of God’s House

HAG.1.1-2.text: The LORD speaks to the leaders about rebuilding the temple

HAG.1.3-6.text: The LORD asks the people why his house lies in ruins

HAG.1.7-9.text: The LORD tells the people to build his house

HAG.1.10-11.text: The LORD sends drought on the land because of the people

HAG.1.12-13.text: The people obey, and the LORD says he is with the people

HAG.1.14-15.text: The LORD stirs the leaders and people to begin the work

HAG.2.1-2.text: The LORD tells Haggai to speak to the leaders

HAG.2.3-5.text: The LORD tells the leaders and people to be strong and work

HAG.2.6-7.text: The LORD will shake the nations and fill his house with glory

HAG.2.8-9.text: The LORD says the later temple will have greater glory

HAG.2.10-12.text: Haggai asks the priests whether holy meat makes food holy

HAG.2.13-14.text: Haggai says the people and the offerings are defiled

HAG.2.15-17.text: The LORD reminds the people that harvests were small

HAG.2.18-19.text: The LORD promises to bless the people from this day

HAG.2.20-22.text: The LORD tells Zerubbabel he will overturn the kingdoms

HAG.2.23-23.text: The LORD chooses Zerubbabel as his signet ring
